description:
Do something different! Apple is seeking a creative and dedicated Optical Module Engineer to contribute to the definition and delivery of innovative optical technologies for Apple’s next-generation vision display products. A successful candidate will possess exceptional technical skills and strong communication and leadership abilities to collaborate effectively with various Apple internal cross-functional teams and external suppliers.

In this role, you will be instrumental in defining critical optical module performance and integration requirements, developing key display features, and implementing effective testing and calibration strategies. Additionally, you will support the module development process from prototype to mass production.

This position provides you with a unique opportunity to translate key product requirements into hardware and features essential for delivering exceptional optical solutions and experiences across Apple’s next-generation products.

Description
Define optical module and feature requirements, including prototype and validation strategies for future Apple vision display products.
Leverage lab equipment to demonstrate display user experience and tradeoffs to key decision makers
Develop integrated simulations and budgets to allocate key user experience figures of merit across multiple component requirements
Support daily activities related to build execution, module setup, data analysis, module failure analysis, and system integration.
Facilitate technical discussions with vendors and internal cross-functional teams.
Collaborate to establish optical module test and calibration requirements.
Foster innovation and introduce new technologies to enhance Apple’s vision display performance and user experience.
Utilize early hardware prototypes to propose solutions and conduct comprehensive trade-off analysis.
Effectively communicate the advantages, disadvantages, and risks to the broader team.

Minimum qualifications
B.S., M.S. or Ph.D. in Optics, EE, Physics, or a related field
4+ years of experience in the relevant industry
Experience in one or more of the following areas: optical design or architecture definition for augmented reality (AR) or virtual reality (VR); display module requirement definition, design, and integration; display/system architecture; optical characterization; numerical modeling; image/video processing and machine learning; human and visual perception; and psychophysical studies.

Preferred qualifications
Experience in one or more of the following areas: development of optical module architectures from concept phase to MP; display technologies (e.g. µOLED, µLED); vendor management and multi-functional collaboration; optical simulation (ZEMAX, LightTools); software/algorithm development, programming (Python, Matlab); display pipeline optimization.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and leadership abilities.
